segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Magandang hapon pumuli sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I'd like to thank the Secretary and all of the attached agency heads,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: mga regional directors at the leadership ng DOST.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Maraming maraming salamat po sa inyong pagpunta.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So let me begin my statement by quoting Secretary Solidum.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Sabi niya, dapat ramdam ang agham.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And I think that is the best guide for everyone in the agency and for this budget process.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Na lahat po ng ginagawa po natin, dapat ramdam ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Whether immediately naramdaman or eventually maramdaman because we also do research.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Alam po natin na ang tamang paggamit ng aghama teknolohiya,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: sa tamang paggamit ng aghama teknolohiya,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: marami pong magagandang bagay ang pwedeng mangyari.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pwede pong mapataas ang ani ng magsasaka at manging isda.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pwedeng mapahaba ang shelf life ng pagkain.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pwedeng mabawasan ang nasasayang na produkto.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pwedeng mapababa ang gasto sa produksyon, sa enerhiya, sa transportasyon at distribusyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Matutulungan din ang malilihit na negosyo na gumamit ang teknolohiya

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: ngunit mas murang pagkain, gamot at iba pang pangunahing bilihit.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ang DOST po, ramdam na ramdam rin sa pagprotekta ng ating komunidad

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: laban sa baha, bagyo, matinding init, lindol, paguho ng lupa at iba pang mga sakuna.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Sa pamamagitan ng accurate na weather forecasting, hazard mapping, early warning systems,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: flood monitoring and climate resilient technologies,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: mas maagang nakapaghahanda ang mga lokal na pamahalaan at mga mamamayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mas maraming buhay ang naliligtas at

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: pananim, negosyo at imprastraktura ang masisira.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ito po yung malinaw na layunin ng ating budget,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: gawing kapakikipakinabang ang agham sa pang araw-araw na buhay ng Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ang tagumpay ng DOST hindi lamang nasusukat sa dami ng pag-aaral, patent, inventions or innovation,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: dapat naramdaman na nito ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Sa kanilang pang araw-araw na buhay, sa palengke, sa paaralan,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: kung saan sila nagtatrabaho at kung saan pa man.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Alam po natin na sa tamang paggamit ng aghama teknolohiya,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: mas magandang buhay ang maaari nating maipigay sa ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kaya ngayon po, sa pagtutok natin sa budget ng DOST,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: sisiguraduhin po natin na ang bawat pisong inilaan sa aghama teknolohiya

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: ay humahantong sa mga gandang bagay para sa ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kurang bilihin, mas ligtas at handang mga pamayanan,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: mas matatag na kabuhayan at mas maginhawang buhay para sa sambayan ng Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Uglitin ko po, sabi nga po ni Secretary Solidum, dapat ramdam ang aghama.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Alright, with that Secretary, you have the floor.

segments.text: So, Secretary, when we worked on the education budget last year,
